title: Time bound for extracting the first component
statement: For every finite bit string $x$, the one-work-tape machine with its first-component flag enabled and its second-component flag disabled halts within $5(|x|+1)$ steps, outputting the first component returned by the pair parser when parsing succeeds and the empty string when parsing fails.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a finite bit string.
